scripts.dev:collector:news: cd backend && python3 -m src.argus_v2.cli collect-loop --news-only --interval-seconds 300 --news-triggers-provider hybrid
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter frontend lint && cd backend && PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/pycache python3 -m compileall -q src && pnpm check:boundaries
scripts.test: pnpm --filter frontend test && cd backend && pytest -q
scripts.build: pnpm --filter frontend build && cd backend && PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/pycache python3 -m compileall -q src
